copy.tagline: 在ABP框架中集成并操作MongoDB数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在ABP项目中使用MongoDB进行开发。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate and operate MongoDB in your ABP projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're using MongoDB in an ABP project.

howto.what: 当用户询问ABP框架中MongoDB相关问题时，Claude将提供详细的集成指南和代码示例，如定义MongoDbContext、映射集合、配置索引、使用事务等。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ABP MongoDB”、“ABP MongoDbContext”、“ABP Mongo repository”、“ABP Mongo collection”、“ABP Mongo index”、“ABP Mongo transaction”等关键词，或要求处理ABP中的MongoDB相关任务时触发。

say.text: 怎么在ABP MongoDB中启用事务？
say.note: Claude会指导移除禁用事务的代码并设置副本集。

howto.what_en: When asked about MongoDB in ABP Framework, Claude will provide detailed integration guidance and code examples, such as defining MongoDbContext, mapping collections, configuring indexes, and using transactions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like 'ABP MongoDB', 'ABP MongoDbContext', 'ABP Mongo repository', 'ABP Mongo collection', 'ABP Mongo index', 'ABP Mongo transaction', or requests help with MongoDB-related tasks in ABP.

say_en.text: How to define MongoDbContext in ABP?
say_en.note: Claude will show example code inheriting AbpMongoDbContext.
Claude will demonstrate using modelBuilder or attributes.
Claude will guide to remove disabling code and set up replica set.
